title: How to get a girlfriend – A Feminist Chauvinist's opinion on women, love
summary: A four-hour Christmas monologue on dating, women and relationships. NH rejects pickup-artist game and casual sex based on his own past as a serial seducer. He argues for building identity first, meeting women in real life, and an evolutionary sea-versus-mountain view of masculine and feminine roles. He ends by praising commitment and marriage.
claims: Pickup-artist game means tricking women, which shows a man secretly believes women would not want him as he is; NH teaches no game at all
Before taking dating advice, look at the adviser's real life: most pickup artists end up lonely, without a wife or children
NH only became attracted to women around 19-20, had his first real kiss around 20 and lost his virginity at 21; at 27 he was in a lifelong committed relationship
For 2-3 years he was a serial seducer seeing 3-4 women a week purely for sex; it never fulfilled him and it hurt those women
Bachelors in their 40s-50s with hundreds of sexual partners are, in his experience, all miserable
There is no single soul mate; tens of thousands of people could be a good match for you
Men and women are not interchangeable; a relationship rests on gendered power relations, and treating the sexes as equal in nature is cruel
Women must be understood through both biology and culture: a purely biological view vilifies them, a purely cultural one puts them on a pedestal
Know why you want a girlfriend; don't date from peer pressure; being a virgin or never kissed does not make you less of a man
What men call lust is often a need for touch, hugs and intimacy, which is normal and not weak
A girlfriend will not cure loneliness; women avoid needy men, so first become your own best friend
Build yourself before seeking a partner, but don't wait to be perfect or ready
From 14 to 21 NH spent about seven years working on himself with almost no relationships
Looksmaxxing has limits, but it matters mostly because it changes how you feel about yourself and how others treat you
NH refuses to lie, because keeping track of lies is too tiring
A weak identity that grows intertwined with a partner shatters on breakup; a couple must stay two individuals or it becomes codependent
Start dating lightly around 16-17; teenage romance offers little and the time is better spent on yourself
A girlfriend is a potential lifelong mate; several sexual partners is fine only inside committed relationships
Casual sex left him empty, made him meaner and degraded his ability to love
Hypergamy concentrates casual sex among the top 5-10% of men, and even they are not made happy by it
School years from about 14 to 20-23 are where most dating potential lies; use them to learn to talk to and understand girls
Hobbies are the second-best place to meet a partner; most couples he knows met through a shared hobby
Avoid dating apps like Tinder: they are skewed toward women's selection (he contrasts real-life selectivity of ~20% with ~95% on apps) and their users are rarely girlfriend material
Cold approaches work maybe once in 100; build a connection, play on ambiguity, and declare intentions at the right moment, neither too early nor too late
He was rejected about 15 times in a row before learning; rejection is normal for men and builds toughness
A gorgeous woman could land about 100 of 100 men she flirts with; the most gorgeous man might get 10 of 100 women
The friend zone is your own fault; if she only wants friendship and you want romance, leave
Women are allergic to patheticness, desperation and weakness; pity kills attraction
Stay somewhat mysterious: never let a woman feel she understands and controls you 100%
Taking rejection calmly signals options; several women came back about two weeks after turning him down
Men select mainly on visual fertility markers; women select on many status markers: height, face, health, social standing, wealth, humour, stability
To be attractive: looksmax, train, get a good job, build wealth for a family, and develop personality and humour
The men he knows with the most beautiful partners are not handsome but funny and charismatic
Show your sexuality but keep it under control: uncontrolled reads as creepy, none at all makes you the gay best friend
In his view consent is mostly body language, and asking permission to kiss kills the tension
Delay sex with a new partner to avoid becoming a slave to your sex drive and to help her stop seeing sex as her only value
Male desire is visual and primal, female desire emotional; female sexuality is more sustainable and family structures are built around it
Women are drawn to protective violence, such as a man defending her from a harasser, even when they criticise toxic masculinity
Women are like the sea and men like mountains: the feminine constantly pushes for movement and cannot stand stagnation
Shit tests are positive challenges proving she is invested; neither give in nor get angry, just stay stoic
When she vents about her day, do not offer solutions; listen
Say yes to some demands and no to others; after a no she is upset for about five minutes, then happier
If a girlfriend says you spend too much time at the gym, treat it as a test and keep training; she chose you partly because you lift
Many female insecurities come from an evolved fear of abandonment
About four years earlier NH was borderline obese at 240 lb; body dysmorphia hid it from him and his partner never criticised him
Keep your physique, strength and identity as a sign of respect for your partner, because her kindness lets you decline
Men must cook, clean and do their own laundry; a 28-year-old who cannot cook is pathetic
Leave a relationship that is truly incompatible; NH does not care about money, has not checked his bank account in about three years, and could not be with a money-driven woman
A tall, masculine friend was dumped two days after crying in front of his girlfriend
Never hit a woman except to protect a life; if constant nagging becomes psychological violence, leave
Women crave attention as men crave intimacy; cooking for her or giving her your coat are signs of commitment
Masculinity fills its own glass first, then gives from abundance; don't put her first in everything or spoil her
Treated well, women stay faithful for life; widowers remarry far more often than widows
He believes his past manipulation of women created bitter women who distrust men
Recently two women on a beach offered him a threesome; he walked away and hid behind a dumpster
Sex 50 times with one partner builds something; sex with 50 different people builds nothing, and pleasure improves with a familiar partner
Men going their own way are really men going nowhere; masculinity reaches a ceiling without femininity to push it further
He cites the mouse utopia experiment as a warning of societal collapse when sexual norms break down
Freedom is found in self-restriction; following every urge is animal, not free
Marriage is a cultural institution built around female biology to keep men with their children; fear of commitment is masculine regression
Men can start families in their 40s-50s while women face a biological clock
Before marrying he asked himself whether he could have only one sexual partner for life; the answer was yes
A soul mate is not found but made through commitment
